wins.text: Q2 revenue of $678M grew 27% YoY and 7% sequentially, exceeding the high end of prior guidance by 5%; excluding strategic commercial contracts, growth accelerated to 30% YoY and 10% sequentially
U.S. commercial revenue grew 55% YoY (70% ex-strategic contracts) to $159M; U.S. commercial TCV booked surged 152% YoY to $262M; U.S. commercial customer count grew 83% YoY to 295 customers

Record GAAP net income of $134M (20% margin) and record GAAP operating income of $105M (16% margin); seventh consecutive quarter of GAAP profitability; adjusted operating margin expanded to 37%, Rule of 40 score reached 64

U.S. government revenue grew 24% YoY and 8% sequentially to $278M; strongest U.S. government bookings quarter since 2022; awarded CDAO Maven contract with initial $153M order and up to $480M over 5 years
Total TCV booked of $946M, up 47% YoY; 27 deals worth $10M or more closed in Q2; net dollar retention increased 300 bps sequentially to 114%; total remaining deal value of $4.3B, up 26% YoY

risks.text: International commercial revenue grew only 15% YoY and declined 1% sequentially to $148M due to continued headwinds in Europe, underperforming the U.S. commercial segment significantly
Revenue from strategic commercial contracts declining sharply — fell to $9M in Q2 and guided to $6M–$8M in Q3 vs. $15M in Q3 2023, representing a meaningful revenue headwind
Adjusted expenses expected to ramp through the back half of the year as the company invests in product pipeline and technical infrastructure, creating potential margin pressure relative to H1
Adjusted free cash flow of $144M–$149M in Q2 with full-year guidance of $800M–$1B implies significant back-half weighting dependent on government and commercial year-end collections timing
Geopolitical risks flagged by CEO including potential severe violent interactions in the Middle East, which could affect government contract timing and global operations

guidance_items.detail: Full year 2024 revenue raised to $2.742B–$2.750B (midpoint $2.746B), representing ~23% YoY growth; Q3 2024 revenue guided to $697M–$701M
U.S. commercial revenue guidance raised to in excess of $672M for full year 2024, representing at least 47% growth
Full year adjusted income from operations raised to $966M–$974M; Q3 adjusted income from operations guided to $233M–$237M
Adjusted free cash flow guidance maintained at $800M–$1B; GAAP operating income and net income expected in each quarter of 2024

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: Specifics of Warp Speed product architecture and how it integrates with or replaces legacy ERP/MES systems
Barriers to adoption among legacy defense prime contractors for reindustrialization software
Pace and conversion rate of boot camp participants into paying production customers
